capability.summary: Slim docs/qc/proofs/ tracking — stop tracking the per-task logs/, oracles/, and raw/ subdirectories (the bulk of the audit duplication, ~75% of governance noise per task). Keep verdict.json, proof.manifest.json, and the human-readable *.md / operator-guidance.md tracked as the attestation surface. Tamper-evidence remains in logs/compiler.log (hash-chained) and in commit trailers (Gov-Verdict / Gov-Attestation). The gov-commit script still runs `git add docs/qc/proofs/<task>/` and silently picks up only the tracked files; the ignored subtrees are local-only and reproducible by running gov:check.
capability.operator_override: Operator authorized a one-line edit to docs/qc/compiler/obligation-rules.json (add '.gitignore' to governance_policy path_group) so that '.gitignore' has a binding and this gitignore-proofs task can pass GOV-BIND-001. WA scope normally excludes docs/qc/compiler/**.

controls.description: After this commit, every docs/qc/proofs/<task>/logs/, /oracles/, and /raw/ subtree is gitignored. verdict.json, proof.manifest.json, and *.md remain tracked.
controls.test: git check-ignore docs/qc/proofs/20260513-export-loops-zip/logs/O-CI.log returns 0; git ls-files docs/qc/proofs/ | grep -E '/(logs|oracles|raw)/' returns no rows.
